coinbase_manual.notes: vault_usdc = HY LTV Buffer balance (generic high-yield leverage defense — not product-branded USDC/USDG, not One Card float). One Card paydown = Morpho new principal refinance. one_card_security_deposit_usdc = USDC securing the card; avail credit ≈ deposit − balance. card_balance null so live YNAB wins.

robinhood.notes: Primary ••••9737 = equity book + optional margin to fund USDG. Agentic ••••1752 = fund manager equities. USDG Earn (Robinhood Earn / Morpho ~7% est.) is manual: app Crypto→Earn; may roll into portfolio total, not a clean MCP cash field. usdg_earn_usdg = principal currently lent.

ynab.notes: Token at ~/.config/ynab/token. Auto-picks One Card + RH Checking + X Money (Plaid often names X Money as Checking – ####). X Money cash pays ~6% APY (product rate; confirm in app).

braiins.notes: Owner 2026-08-05: raised pool payout threshold from 0.005 → 0.01 BTC (Braiins UI). FCC next-payout ETA / progress read this override — do not re-infer from payout history alone (history still clusters at old 0.005 until the first 0.01 payout lands). Braiins free on-chain floor remains 0.005; this is our account rule, not the pool minimum.

pi_sync.notes: P0 2026-08-03: Mac is the live producer (RH MCP, Braiins/YNAB/CB/Sheet). Pi is offline consumer of pushed snapshots — no live venue secrets required on Pi for feed display. max_age_hours=6; mcp_timeout_s=240; Mac launchd TREASURY_SKIP_PI=1. push_files includes CB + YNAB cash + Sheet so phone FCC does not show stale/empty red. Ask Grok needs SuperGrok/XAI auth on the host serving FCC (Mac localhost or synced session on Pi). Override: TREASURY_PI_SSH, TREASURY_PI_ROOT, TREASURY_RH_MAX_AGE_HOURS, TREASURY_RH_MCP_TIMEOUT_S, TREASURY_SKIP_PI, TREASURY_SKIP_PUSH_PI=1.
